description: This file implements methods for the AWCContainerBase class, providing system resource information such as memory and processor info, and network interfaces.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns a new instance of AWCMemoryInfo containing memory usage details.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns a new instance of AWCProcessorInfo containing CPU usage details.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns nullptr, indicating no network interfaces are provided.
